name: mem_dirty_ratio
params: dirty:string:前台比例,留空只读|bg:string:后台比例,可空
cmd: [ -n $dirty ] && echo $dirty > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio 2>&1; [ -n $bg ] && echo $bg > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio 2>&1; echo -n 'dirty_ratio='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio; echo -n 'bg_ratio='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio; echo -n 'dirty_expire_ms='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_expire_centisecs
